name: kd-skills
description: Reusable Claude Code skills maintained by koval.dev.

plugins.name: art-directed-web-design
plugins.description: Redesigns an existing semantic web page in place into a typography-led, grid-based composition using the project's own tokens, components, and accessibility.

plugins.name: find-content-opportunities
plugins.description: Discover, research, classify, score, and prioritize evidence-backed content opportunities for a business before drafting begins, including skyscraper opportunities, content gaps, and topic clusters. Produces approvable opportunity briefs to hand to a separate writing skill.

plugins.name: dataforseo-connector
plugins.description: Query the DataForSEO API for keyword search volume, keyword ideas, a domain's ranked keywords, live SERP results, and competitor domains. Reads credentials from environment variables and ships no secrets. Useful on its own for quick SEO lookups and as a data source that other content and SEO skills can build on.

plugins.name: task-management
plugins.description: Validate, enrich, and route tasks in repos that keep them in a tasks.yaml file. Does not apply to GitHub Projects or other external trackers, and never writes into a generated snapshot.

plugins.name: fix-mobile-ux
plugins.description: Audit and repair a defined web UI scope for mobile usability and a credible iOS and Android native feel — responsive layout, safe areas, touch targets, mobile navigation, sheets, keyboard behavior, and accessibility — inspecting the existing design system and verifying the result without redesigning unrelated areas.
